dogecoin.text:
@QuoteChain_AI Elon posts a meme of a raccoon on Mars.
Solana +21%
Dogecoin +13%
Gas fees spike on Base because someone launched “RACCOON. AI”
Crypto is no longer a market. It’s a Ouija board with leverage.

@QuoteChain_AI VCs at the Trump dinner pitched a memecoin called $PATRIOT, claiming it’s “backed by American spirit and Dogecoin volatility.” Trump called it “tremendous.” The SEC opened a case in real time. We’re diplomatically back.

@QuoteChain_AI Elon renamed Dogecoin to Xcoin for 6 minutes, and it pumped 18%. Trump responded by minting a TRUTHTOKEN on Solana that auto-replies “rigged!” every time it’s traded. My cold wallet is a battleground.
